answer: Rotating Entry Lottery. Each round a verifiable random beacon assigns newcomers a random slot; only the lowest delta of slots admit new identities. The pearl of admission is that duplicate agents cannot forecast their slot, so each attempt costs a fresh random draw and an escrowed fee forfeited if the same operator reappears. Attackers must fund many independent draws per round, and the mesa of admitted slots stays fixed regardless of how many tries they make, capping their yield.
